title: Order webhook event (by arrangement with Mervia only)
description: Not part of item 8 by default: Mervia reads orders from GET /orders (openapi.yaml). Only by arrangement with Mervia, a store that declares order_webhook sends this event to Mervia's webhook URL when an order is paid, refunded or cancelled. Signed with X-Mervia-Timestamp (unix seconds) and X-Mervia-Signature (sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256, keyed with the shared secret, over the timestamp header's exact value + '.' + the raw body>). Mervia rejects a signature that does not verify or a timestamp more than 300 seconds from its clock, and refuses a body larger than 256 KB (262,144 bytes) before checking the signature. Deliveries are idempotent on order.id; duplicates of event_id are ignored. The order object is the same as GET /orders returns (order.schema.json), amount rules included: the first order.paid fixes the amounts, a later change travels as order.refunded with the cumulative refunded_total, and order.cancelled counts as a full refund. No customer name, email, phone or address is sent.

event_id.description: Unique per delivery attempt family; Mervia ignores a repeated event_id.
